name: Vareth Cardamom-Black Sesame Stim Drops
description: Small hard-shell drops with a brittle cardamom exterior and a liquid black sesame core that releases a mild synth-caffeine and L-theanine blend. Marketed to desk workers and students pulling long shifts.
flavor_profile: Sharp green cardamom up front, then a warm, nutty black sesame oil burst at the center; mild clean energy onset within fifteen minutes; no crash reported at standard dosage
cultural_context: Popular with BCI-augmented workers who find the cardamom-sesame combo pairs well with focus-mode overlays. Some users report the flavor cues act as a Pavlovian productivity trigger after extended use — a feature Vareth marketing quietly leans into.
story_hooks: A corporate whistleblower has been slipping encoded data into the nutritional batch codes printed on Vareth tubes — someone needs to figure out the cipher
A student using Vareth drops for exam prep discovers her drop tube contains an experimental compound with effects far beyond mild stimulation
Vareth's Tier 2 distribution contract is expiring and a street-level knockoff is undercutting them with a dirtier, stronger formula
